CacheFlags.description: Closed Bazel flags derived from the storage layout, the products budget and the neutral remote cache contract. The startup flag binds one output base, and therefore one server, to one workspace directory; the disk cache garbage collector only runs inside such a persistent server, never under --batch. The remote flags are the Bazel rendering of the contract in the build policy; the access token never appears in a flag: it travels as the one environment entry of the Bazel client that the credential helper reads, and the helper holds only the variable name.

darwin.reason: The macOS JVM opens its classpath from Bazel's byte-wise path strings as UTF-8, so a non-ASCII install base crashes the server at startup (main class not found). Bazel writes the darwin-sandbox profile (sandbox.sb) from the same byte-wise strings but encodes each byte as UTF-8 again, so a non-ASCII output base (sandbox directory, execroot and stats.out) is allow-listed under mojibake and every sandboxed action fails with Operation not permitted unless the base happens to sit under an allow-listed directory such as /private/tmp. Source labels, output names inside the execroot, disk cache and workspace paths accept non-ASCII names.

linux.reason: The Linux JVM resolves the Bazel server classpath from the install base through its byte-wise path strings, so a non-ASCII install base crashes the server at startup (Could not find or load main class, ClassNotFoundException com.google.devtools.build.lib.bazel.Bazel) under every locale tried: unset, POSIX, C, C.UTF-8 and en_US.UTF-8. Output bases, sandbox directories, execroot, source labels, disk cache and workspace paths accept non-ASCII names (an emoji output base built and cached on Linux arm64).

task.reason: The task process runs in the real checkout: its working directory, the declared source-tree and shared-store writes, the loopback control socket and the out-of-tree runtime channel are host state that a Bazel sandbox hides or blocks.

launcher.reason: Action birth binds exact execroot output paths and obtains authority from the owning invocation over its loopback control socket and out-of-tree runtime channel, which a sandbox execroot would change.

test.reason: The test process runs in the real checkout like a task: its working directory, the declared source-tree reads, the loopback control socket and the out-of-tree runtime channel are host state that a Bazel sandbox hides or blocks; the result is cached as a Bazel test result and as a remote cache entry.

uncached.continuous: A long-running service is started on demand and never produced.
uncached.declared: The target declares itself uncacheable: it publishes, deploys or exercises a live environment.
uncached.skipped: The invocation skips the action cache.
uncached.undeclared: cache not declared: the target states no cache policy, so undeclared side effects could be lost on a cache hit and it reruns until it declares one.
uncached.unbounded: outputs not declared: the target says cache true but names no outputs, so a cache hit could not restore what it produced.

FingerprintPlan.description: What the planner leaves per fingerprinted task: the head (host identity, implementation, declared environment, runtime answers) and the paths without a declarable label whose identities the publisher hashes after every plan, fresh or reused.

Limits.description: EN: The traversal, batch, byte, text and throttle limits of the Bazel script. DE: Die Durchlauf-, Stapel-, Byte-, Text- und Drosselgrenzen des Bazel-Skripts.

en.sourceIdentityDepth: The deepest directory nesting the identity of a source tree walks.
en.sourceIdentityEntries: The most entries the identity of a source tree visits.
en.classifyBatch: How many paths are classified at once while the inputs of a plan are expanded.
en.immutableInputBytes: The most bytes of one immutable input the script writes: a snapshot, an overlay or the loader (24 MiB).
en.writeChunkBytes: The size of one write while an immutable input is written (64 KiB).
en.scopeReasonCharacters: The most characters of the reason an out-of-date implementation scope reports.
en.planReasonCharacters: The most characters of the reason a failed plan reuse or planner reports.
en.cacheCollectionThrottleMilliseconds: How long after a cache collection another one of the same kind is answered with the earlier result.

de.sourceIdentityDepth: Die tiefste Verzeichnisverschachtelung, die die Identität eines Quellbaums durchläuft.
de.sourceIdentityEntries: Die meisten Einträge, die die Identität eines Quellbaums besucht.
de.classifyBatch: Wie viele Pfade gleichzeitig klassifiziert werden, während die Eingaben eines Plans entfaltet werden.
de.immutableInputBytes: Die meisten Bytes einer unveränderlichen Eingabe, die das Skript schreibt: ein Schnappschuss, ein Overlay oder der Lader (24 MiB).
de.writeChunkBytes: Die Größe eines Schreibvorgangs, während eine unveränderliche Eingabe geschrieben wird (64 KiB).
de.scopeReasonCharacters: Die meisten Zeichen des Grundes, den ein veralteter Implementierungs-Scope meldet.
de.planReasonCharacters: Die meisten Zeichen des Grundes, den eine fehlgeschlagene Plan-Wiederverwendung oder ein fehlgeschlagener Planer meldet.
de.cacheCollectionThrottleMilliseconds: Wie lange nach einer Cache-Sammlung eine weitere derselben Art mit dem früheren Ergebnis beantwortet wird.
